name: Thunderhorn Totem
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains.  Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
narrative.objectives: Bring 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws to Mull Thunderhorn.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, adventurer. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 5 to 10, 4,310 XP in all.

quests.name: Poison Water
quests.objectiveText: Bring 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Plainstrider Talons to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof.

quests.name: Winterhoof Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem at the Winterhoof Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.

quests.name: Thunderhorn Totem
quests.objectiveText: Bring 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws to Mull Thunderhorn.

quests.name: Thunderhorn Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.

quests.name: Wildmane Totem
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Wildmane Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.

quests.name: Thunderhorn's Report
quests.objectiveText: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
